title: Petal value v1
description: What a map's token is worth in dollars, and how much of it there is: its price from NEAR Intents' 1Click list, its supply from its own chain, and its reading's totals at that price. One per map, named by the map's address, read again to refresh. A token 1Click doesn't price has price null: no price, never a guess.

about.description: the map, by its address (its card's id)

asset.description: what is priced: the asset its reading's holdings name (an EVM token's address in lower case, a Solana mint, NEAR), and its symbol

price.description: dollars for one whole token, as 1Click lists it, or else DefiLlama, or null: no price

source.description: where the price is from, in a word: 1click (NEAR Intents' list), or defillama (its open prices) for what 1Click doesn't list

ref.description: which asset it is there (1Click's asset id, DefiLlama's chain:address and its confidence), and why when it isn't the token itself (NEAR, priced as wNEAR)

supply.description: how much of it there is, read from its own chain, in whole tokens, or null when the chain didn't say

ref.description: the call it answered: totalSupply() on eip155:1:0x…, ft_total_supply on near:mainnet:…, getTokenSupply on solana:…, NEAR's total supply at a block

snapshot.description: the reading its totals are of: the map's newest when it was read

measure.description: the reading's own measure, the one its flower draws by default, or null

totals.description: each amount measure of the reading held in this asset: its sum, and that at the price, or null with no price
